title: What If a Capybara Moved Into Your House? #shorts

lines.text: A capybara just moved into your house, and a bird is already sitting on his head!
He's the biggest rodent on Earth, over one hundred thirty pounds of pure chill.
His teeth never stop growing, so your couch is now a snack.
He can hold his breath for five minutes, so your bathtub is his now.
And he's calmer than you are, because a capybara just moved into your house!

sources: https://www.discovermagazine.com/6-reasons-why-capybaras-are-so-popular-45578 (largest rodents; hold breath up to five minutes; rest near caimans, bird perched on head; calm reputation)
https://www.nhm.ac.uk/discover/things-you-might-not-know-about-capybaras.html (greater capybara over 60 kg / ~130 lb; incisors grow continuously; five minutes underwater; relaxed demeanour)

facts.hedge: house scenario is a comedic what-if; loop ending is a joke
